evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark, which measures how well autonomous agents perform end-to-end professional knowledge work that depends on visual understanding.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Each task requires an agent to extract and combine information from multiple visually dense files, such as CAD blueprints, electronics schematics, radiographs, complex charts and geospatial maps, and to produce a standalone deliverable in .xlsx, .pptx, .pdf, .docx, .html or .png format.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: MKA contains 200 tasks across 10 economic sectors.
